metadata.name: asset_controller
metadata.description: The Asset Controller Program (ACP) enables core asset management functionality for newly issued assets, including transfer controls and transaction privacy.

instructions.name: issue_tokens
docs: issue shares of the rwa asset

instructions.name: revoke_tokens
docs: revoke shares of the rwa asset

instructions.name: seize_tokens
docs: seize shares of the rwa asset

instructions.name: update_metadata
docs: edit metadata of the rwa asset

errors.name: TransferMintNotApproved
errors.msg: Transfer hasnt been approved for the asset mint

errors.name: TransferFromNotApproved
errors.msg: Transfer hasnt been approved for from account

errors.name: TransferToNotApproved
errors.msg: Transfer hasnt been approved for to account

errors.name: TransferAmountNotApproved
errors.msg: Transfer hasnt been approved for the specified amount

errors.name: InvalidPdaPassedIn
errors.msg: Pda passed in for transfer is wrong

errors.name: WindowCapExceeded
errors.msg: Amount exceeds the cumulative window cap

errors.name: AmountDoesNotRequireTimelock
errors.msg: Operation amount does not require a timelock

errors.name: InvalidOperationAmount
errors.msg: Pending operation amount must be positive

errors.name: PendingOperationNotEffective
errors.msg: Pending operation is not yet effective

errors.name: InvalidPendingOperation
errors.msg: Pending operation does not match the requested operation

fields.name: authority
docs: authority has the ability to seize, freeze token accounts, etc.

types.name: CapsConfig
docs: Single-instruction ceilings in base units. Zero disables the corresponding cap.

fields.name: identity_registry
docs: identity registry to which the account belongs

fields.name: num_wallets
docs: number of wallets attached to this identity account

fields.name: proposer
docs: Authorized signer; human role attribution belongs to RBAC.

fields.name: issuance_policies
docs: these are partially for storage only

fields.name: policies
docs: policies to check on transfers or balance changes

fields.name: counters
docs: counters to track the number of holders depending on filters

fields.name: counter_limits
docs: limits to apply on existing counters

types.name: ThrottleConfig
docs: Shared tumbling window, mint/burn timelock, and pending-operation expiry.
